findings.text: The coverage paragraph, echoed at docs/plans/null-identification-authority.html:48, says the 22086/43 pure remainder arm is "non-converged on the same active-set cycle that stalls the load-bearing row", but that arm's own emission (reports fence arms/new-22086-43-pure.json) records termination_reason "active_set_settled" (FixedPointTerminationReason 10) while the load-bearing 21978/35 pure emission records "active_set_cycle_detected" (7); the asserted mechanism identity is contradicted by the arm's record, so a reader takes "the same cycle" as shared physics it is not.

_panel reads radius, height and wall from the producer (left) archive only and draws that one wall polygon on both panels, so the evidence record's "each panel draws the vessel from its own resolved wall polygon" is not what the code does; the two archives' geometry is bit-identical (verified here), so the committed figure is right by coincidence of inputs, but a future pair with differing grids would draw both panels against the producer's geometry with no assertion to catch it.

"The receipt states the current-tree 22086/43 emission's compile-line count once" attributes the count to the receipt, but no receipt carries a compile-line field (the campaign summary and both 22086/43 arm receipts have none), so a reader sent there finds nothing; the count itself is correct (462 lines, 2 `Compiling jit(solve)`) and stated once in the plan under the named marker.

"Every location the receipt carries is stated from the repository root, so the record resolves after the worktree that produced it is removed" — the five-deep `..` in left.root is calibrated to the producing worktree's depth: it resolves from any same-depth worktree but to /.config/reckon/crew/reports/... (no such path) from the main checkout ~/Code/nova, where the merged record is normally read, so the portability claim holds only in trees at that depth.

The panel test asserts only status == 0 and a non-empty file, so the figure's required composition — line contours on the shared level array, both null sets in their styles, the wall drawn — is unpinned and a regression that drops the wall, drops the counterpart nulls, or switches to filled contours still passes.

justifications.durability: tests/test_bank_drift_paired_probe.py:86 pins the merge count in both directions with a passing control at :106 and the unpaired-arm path at :146, but :220's panel test asserts only exit status and file size, so a regression in the figure's mandated composition (shared level array, both null sets, wall) would still pass.
justifications.evidence: The done-when's gates reproduce from the artefacts — the plan's count of 462 `Compiling ` lines with 2 `Compiling jit(solve)` matches the lane log under the named marker JAX_LOG_COMPILES=1 (compile-22086-43.txt), the panel re-renders byte-identical from the two resolve archives, and the pinned tests pass here (6 passed in 13.00 s) — while two of the record's attributions do not check against those artefacts.
justifications.fit: benchmarks/bank_drift_paired_probe.py:768 keeps the probe's argparse-subcommand idiom, reads npz archives keyed exactly as the resolver writes them, and draws through the shared nova.media painters (draw_flux_contours, draw_wall, draw_nulls) with no plan or ticket identifiers in symbols, filenames or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Both deliverables landed and were independently reproduced: docs/figures/null-identification-authority/bank-drift-probe/receipt.json re-derives twelve rows with rows_missing 0 under `merge --expected-rows 12` over the committed arms, and the pair is committed at docs/figures/null-identification-authority/bank-drift-probe/21978-35-pure-panels.png.
justifications.scope_discipline: All 8 files changed across 1d7f4bc3..HEAD fall inside the six declared write paths (benchmarks/bank_drift_paired_probe.py, tests/test_bank_drift_paired_probe.py, docs/figures/null-identification-authority/bank-drift-probe, docs/evidence/archive/null-identification-authority-landed.html, docs/plans/null-identification-authority.html, and the reports fence), with nothing outside them.
